statement: On the problem-185 test distribution with N<=1000, BnB with greedy coloring bound completes well within 1700ms under normal system load, achieving score 100 regardless of whether the BnB cutoff is set to 1700ms or 1800ms. The solution is robust to time allocation changes within a 300ms window.
regime: N <= 1000, M <= 500000, 2s time limit, normal system load
mechanism: BnB with degeneracy ordering and greedy coloring bound prunes the search tree efficiently enough that instances in this distribution are solved in well under 1700ms. The 1700-1800ms cutoff range is deep in the safe zone, not near the boundary.
applicability_bounds: Holds for N<=1000 graphs in the problem-185 test distribution. May not hold for denser or larger graphs, or under heavy system load (iter-1 showed score drops under load).
